title: Avocado Juggling Physics Simulator
description: A ReadyPlayer.me avatar stands on a platform and juggles avocados using physics simulation with conservation of momentum. The user spawns avocados, adjusts throw force vectors, toggles gravity strength, and manages the juggling pattern while tracking total system energy. Full undo/redo support lets the user rewind and replay any parameter change or spawn action.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net. Load readyplayer.me.glb as a humanoid avatar centered on a circular platform at origin, and Avocado.glb as a template for spawnable juggling objects. Use GLTFLoader from three/addons. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0,1.8,4) looking at the avatar's chest, with OrbitControls. Add hemisphere light (sky 0x87CEEB, ground 0x444444, intensity 1.2) and a directional light with shadows from (3,5,2). Implement a custom physics engine: each avocado has position, velocity, mass (0.2kg), and is subject to configurable gravity (default -9.81). Enforce conservation of kinetic+potential energy within 1% tolerance, displayed in a HUD. Create a left-side HTML panel with these controls: (1) 'Spawn Avocado' button that clones the avocado model and launches it upward from the avatar's right hand position with a default velocity of (1,5,-0.5), max 6 avocados active; (2) Three sliders for throw force X/Y/Z components ranging -10 to 10; (3) A gravity slider from 0 to 20 m/s²; (4) A 'Remove Last' button that despawns the most recent avocado; (5) Undo and Redo buttons that track a history stack of all state changes including spawns, removals, slider adjustments, storing full simulation snapshots. Each avocado follows parabolic arcs and bounces off an invisible bounding box (3m cube around avatar) with coefficient of restitution 0.9. When two avocados collide (sphere intersection r=0.05), apply elastic collision formulas preserving momentum. The HUD shows: total kinetic energy, total potential energy, total system energy, avocado count, and history stack depth. Animate the avatar's arms to subtly oscillate using sin(time) on the forearm bones if available. Use requestAnimationFrame with delta-time integration. Style the page with a dark gradient background and semi-transparent control panel.
